verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents its own whole-vault bulk operations: importing many items at once from other managers or exports, and exporting the entire vault. A hands-on report also shows `bw list` returning every item at once. No documented bulk edit, move, delete or share action across selected items appears in the evidence, so arbitrary bulk changes would need scripting the CLI or `bw serve` API, which earns no credit. missing for 10: documented bulk edit/move/delete/share operations across selected items, agent-facing bulk commands in the CLI/API/MCP server, independent corroboration of bulk workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
